mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_sessions ( session_id, user_id, refresh_token_hash, ip_first, ip_last, ua_first, ua_last, created_at, last_seen_at, expires_at, status ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, CAST(#{ipFirst} AS inet), CAST(#{ipLast} AS inet), #{uaFirst}, #{uaLast}, #{createdAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.auth_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
